header.title: Summary of Haruhisa Sonoda's Skills and Achievements

content.introduction: This time, we introduce Haruhisa Sonoda, a skilled bowling player based in Aichi Prefecture. He has achieved excellent results in numerous tournaments in recent years and is attracting attention. Let's take a quick look back at his achievements and charm.

section1.title: 1. MVP at the 23rd Central Japan Championship
section1.text: In the 23rd Central Japan Championship held in June 2023, the Nagoya Branch B Team won the championship. Sonoda was selected as the MVP, proving his skills. He contributed as a team member and achieved remarkable results individually.
